title: GlobalSim execution check and Umalytics integration assessment
recommendation: Integrate the pinned forward simulator with independent recorded-observation comparison and a compatibility gate for BOTH simulation and inference. Use original race occurrence/version evidence to select separately versioned actual engine/data bundles. Older races without available compatible historical engines, unknown/conflicting version evidence and unsupported future updates display recorded replay only. Future provisional inference requires explicit bounded/named policy and persistent warning. The user reports new local race-time logging, but its unpublished field semantics and real release-era mappings remain Codex verification/configuration work. The delivered selector/gateway are tested; the production registry intentionally asserts no coverage. Recorded course/distance remains the normal captured-input path. Prior empirical evidence remains five observed matches, one historical mismatch and one incomplete pre-fix race; no new real simulation was added.

summary.additionalRaceCollectionNote: No additional race is required merely to implement the integration. A locally available capture with preserved setup and established original occurrence/version evidence is the next production acceptance fixture. Original uploads remain unchanged; collection/export dates do not establish support eras.
summary.additionalRaceContextRequiredScope: The original pre-fix room attachment only; new captures are evaluated from their own recorded metadata.

evidenceScope: Compiled and executed the unmodified pinned source in Linux with Rust1.90.0.
The 63 repository regression fixtures are author-supplied; this does not independently authenticate their origins or rerun the entire claimed corpus.
The six additional user captures were converted using initial fields plus exact public-master mappings. Expected replay observations never entered simulator inputs.
Five user Team Trials races match every compared result, pre-finish frame field and supported event field at the documented replay representation; the practice race diverges.
Exact here means the compared observations at available sampled times and wire precision. It does not establish all hidden variables, unsampled ticks, all event types, or universal equivalence.
No simulation inputs or seeds were fitted to the expected outputs, and the engine source was not patched.
The full Rust unit suite was not run. Upstream TESTING.md reports133 passes and11 existing failures.

The user reports that the prior mismatching room race was originally run before multiple anniversary mechanics updates. This provenance is not encoded by the export timestamp and does not establish an exact historic engine version.
The seventh capture decodes successfully but omits current course identity and grade. It is an incomplete-input case, not a seventh simulated race or an additional mismatch.

Both room captures share a decodable serialization layout and header marker. This is not proof of identical mechanics, nor a finding about the official client's complete backward-compatibility policy.
Course-capture update reviewed current app commit 67443a667998c48cd20685b34bfefc356bd1064f; app source was not modified by this handoff update.
12 targeted synthetic tests executed actual Python capture functions and raw-export.ts/share.ts using importer-equivalent source/options; the full importer entry point was not executed.
Four source gaps are confirmed and separately labeled: direct alias loss, courseSource loss, normalized-distance feedback and course-only context replacement before ambiguity checks.
The updated adapter re-prepared the original seven captures without a simulator: six ready with unchanged canonical input hashes, one needs_input, all original file hashes unchanged.
No post-fix actual game capture was supplied; synthetic input readiness is not an additional simulator parity result.
Latest user policy supersedes unconditional current-inference fallback: both mechanics families require original-race compatibility before work/cache use.
New local race-time logging is user-reported development beyond the inspected published app revision; no raw alias or actual release cutoff was invented.
This update ran 100 pure Python tests and 16 executable frontend guard groups; 51 Python tests are new selector/gateway checks. The production registry is intentionally empty.
The original seven capture-file hashes and prior diagnostic bridge report were verified unchanged. No actual simulator/inference engine or Windows app ran for this update.

integration.entryPoint: Existing Umalytics local Python HTTP service managing one bounded child process per evaluation initially
integration.rationale: The local Python service owns version eligibility, immutable artifacts and bounded child execution. Simulation failure may use only a separately eligible inference implementation.
integration.runtimeProfile: Use examples/v74-settings.json and data/v70-skill-data.json as an explicit pinned reference; do not rely on default generic solver or legacy skill table.
integration.stateExposure: Normal output includes six frame fields plus result and event metadata. Complete pace/downhill/target-speed/cooldown/RNG decision traces require opt-in instrumentation in an upstream change or pinned fork.
integration.traceConstraint: Record existing state and actual predicate/RNG results without reevaluating stateful conditions or drawing extra random numbers.
integration.compatibility: Select documented original-race era/build/master coverage per region/mode, then bind actual simulator and inference artifacts/data independently. Keep semantic policy/gate versions and real code/resource identities in caches.
integration.fallback: Only a separately eligible compatible inference bundle or explicitly permitted, persistently warned future inference plan may follow simulation failure. Unsupported older, unknown/conflicting and future-uncovered races display recorded-only.
integration.meaningOfMatch: Agreement with the recorded observations at their native precision and cadence; internal state remains simulation-derived.
integration.distributionNote: No project-level license file or Cargo license declaration was found at the inspected commit; third-party mimalloc notices exist. Reuse terms remain to be confirmed before bundling a distribution.
integration.implementationStatus: Adapter v2, comparator, diagnostic runtime, original-race selector, production gateway, immutable bindings and frontend guards are delivered/tested. App routing, timestamp mapper, actual support registry, versioned inference dispatch, observational UI and Windows packaging remain Codex integration tasks.
integration.courseAcquisition: Use existing bounded room-response join and raw captured identity. Known exact race-instance resolves course/distance/grade/time; do not restore routine course selection.
integration.productionEntryPoint: evaluate_for_analysis(capture, registry, simulator_bindings, *, evidence=None, context=None, inference_bindings=None)
integration.inferenceReauthorization: revalidate_inference_plan before actual worker execution or model cache access; fresh evidence/registry and measured artifact/data hashes required
integration.diagnosticEntryPoint: evaluate_capture / evaluate_capture_diagnostic; comparison evidence only, never product analysis permission

Apply documented replay representation and quantization; preserve dense simulation frames for matching actual observation times.
Record the first mismatch with time, runner, field, expected and actual values.
Test new captures across relevant modes, skills and tracks before broadening support.

Populate only evidenced original-race support mappings and actual immutable simulator/inference bundles; the delivered production registry is empty.

Preserve completed course/distance work; inspect and fix remaining direct-alias, courseSource, raw raceDistance and course-only ambiguity gaps only if still present locally.

Keep the seven original diagnostic expectations immutable. Validate a new enriched timestamped capture independently, without deriving a supported era from export time or fitting mechanics to an old mismatch.
Run actual importer/exporter/share/service, TypeScript/Svelte, worker/cache and Windows packaging acceptance checks after application integration.
Add hidden-state instrumentation only as a separately versioned capability with non-perturbing trace-on/off equivalence evidence.

collectorFindings: observer.py generates captured_at from datetime.now(timezone.utc) when observing an eligible response, and generates the filename timestamp separately at export write.
race_extract.py copies a limited set of course/seed/grade/time-of-day/condition metadata. Its exported top-level fields do not include an original occurrence timestamp or game/master version.
The retained practice category merges several upstream route groups. These files do not preserve enough route identity to independently distinguish fresh-race observation from saved-replay retrieval.
Absence from this reduced export does not prove that the upstream response never contained another saved-room date field.

Course metadata is copied from supported same-response positions, including a saved race_result sibling. No cross-response room setup cache exists, and responses without a race scenario do not produce a race file.
roomMatchDateAndVersionAudit.timeFieldCaveat: start_time_type is treated by Umalytics as time-of-day, not calendar time. GlobalSim maps its RaceTime enum value 1 to Morning, but native equivalence of RoomMatch StartTimeType was not independently recovered in this audit. Preserve raw value 1; this roster has no time-dependent skill predicates in the pinned table.
roomMatchDateAndVersionAudit.compatibilityConclusion: Replay decoding/playback of stored trajectories and re-simulation from initial conditions are different capabilities. Both supplied files decode under one layout. Re-simulation parity across old mechanics revisions requires appropriate historical code/data or a proven equivalent profile. The old mismatch plus user provenance supports investigation of ruleset drift, not a categorical claim that the official game has no backward compatibility.
roomMatchDateAndVersionAudit.courseContextRequest: Superseded as a routine workflow by the new room-response join. The unchanged pre-fix room attachment still needs independently supplied original setup, while a post-fix enriched capture is evaluated separately.
